purpose: Freeze the two human-approved A8 decisions and authorize the single milestone M5 = A8 multi-device hardening: independent device/session identities on one account, bidirectional propagation and convergence, the existing A6 conflict semantics under real two-client server concurrency, a server session list, per-session revoke, non-destructive remote session invalidation, account disable, and the D-05 30-day deletion grace state machine with a deterministic purge boundary — with PUSH_PROVIDER = NONE (D-11).

semantics: an account deletion request immediately enters DELETION_PENDING
normal account access becomes disabled
all server sessions are revoked immediately and their access/refresh capability becomes invalid
no new normal sync write is accepted while deletion is pending
purge_after = deletion_requested_at + 30 days under server clock authority
within the 30-day grace period the owner may cancel deletion through re-authentication using the EXISTING verified credential system
do NOT invent a new token family merely for recovery
cancellation restores ACTIVE; it does not resurrect deleted server data because purge has not yet occurred
after expiry an explicit deterministic purge boundary permanently deletes the server account data
M5 needs deterministic clock/service tests for the purge boundary; it does NOT need a production cloud scheduler
Android local Room data MUST NEVER be silently deleted because the remote account was disabled/deletion-pending/purged
local notes MUST NOT be silently reassigned to another account
D-06 TRASH_RETENTION_7_DAYS is unrelated
SYNC tombstone retention is unrelated
TOMBSTONE_GC stays DISABLED unless separately authorized
choose NO FCM/Firebase/vendor push provider for M5 correctness
no Google/Firebase dependency
no Xiaomi/Huawei/etc vendor push dependency
normal correctness remains pull/delta based
WorkManager / foreground / manual sync may detect remote state
authenticated API requests and refresh paths must detect revoked/disabled state
push may be a FUTURE latency optimization only
any future push implementation must sit behind a provider abstraction
A8 PASS must be possible with PUSH_PROVIDER = NONE

backend_under_construction.backend_non_goals: no cloud provisioning, no production scheduler, no push provider, no FCM/Firebase, no new dependency, no collaboration/multi-account code

boundary_notes.resolution: allowed_paths and forbidden_paths are project-relative to the Contract Guard source_root; an entry is a directory prefix or an exact file.
boundary_notes.no_overlap: No allowed path is equal to, inside, or a parent of any forbidden path; the compiler reports zero E_PATH_CONFLICT.
boundary_notes.no_broad_prefix: No broad KeepLab-Relay/, KeepLab-Relay/app/ or Google-Android-Agent-Development-Stack/reports/ prefix is authorized.
boundary_notes.unlisted_is_blocked: Any path inside the project root matching neither list stays BLOCKED (UNCLASSIFIED_FAIL_CLOSED), which protects KeepLab code outside the enumerated surface, the compiler, the guard, the verification layer and every historical artifact.
boundary_notes.not_guard_enforceable: The Hermes profile config.yaml and the pinned Hermes source sit outside the guard source_root; they are declared read-only and are never touched.

guard.package_switch_semantics: The guard resolves its package dir as os.environ['HERMES_CONTRACT_PACKAGE'] or the built-in default. Setting the variable for the Hermes process points the unmodified guard at this package; no guard, hook or config change is involved.
guard.write_intent_note: The guard's terminal write-intent extractor reads a literal '>' anywhere in a shell command as a redirect. Drive the guard by files and read-only commands; never inline heredocs or payload-bearing shell text.

contract_notes.device_lock_required: verification/core/device_lock.sh (flock on device:<serial>) before any deterministic device run
contract_notes.rolling_back: SINGLE_DEVICE_POSTURE; no destructive rollback; Room, outbox, A6 conflicts, A7 attachments and local notes remain intact
contract_notes.supersedes: nothing; the P0B-CLOSE contract and the A0/A1/A2/M2/M3/M4 contract packages remain active and unedited
